title: Stabilize ropes at one 60 Hz step
requires: A physical supported GPU, shared Slang build toolchain and public-API test harness
scope: Redesign rope integration/length/bend constraints at dt=1/60 with stable bounded correction and explicit stretch tradeoffs. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Long chains, attachments, stiff settings, cold starts, impacts, self-contact where advertised and endpoint/reset cases satisfy the new envelope.
Document the chosen equations, timestep/material semantics and intentional accuracy losses; share Slang physics across adapters and negotiate the new profile explicitly.
Independent tests prove exactly one dt=1/60 advance, bounded algebraic iterations, no spatial rebuild in the solve, and adherence to the predeclared dispatch/work/memory budget.
Publish new-profile quality/energy/performance evidence beside unchanged legacy-profile results; no post-result tolerance changes or per-device physics fork.
